title: Neil Armstrong seemed scared at his speech after the moon landing
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Neil Armstrong seemed scared at his speech after the moon landing, about 1969 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Neil Armstrong comes back. He gives a speech three weeks afterwards and he's giving the speech and he he looks kind of he goes this is a big step for mankind and he looks very kind of scared and sheepish

plain: Neil Armstrong was the American astronaut who first walked on the Moon in 1969. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that when Armstrong gave a speech about three weeks after coming home, calling it a big step for mankind, he looked scared and sheepish. Michels raises it in an episode about the idea that the Moon is an alien spaceship, as a hint that Armstrong may have seen more than he said.
